attempts.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance on node1 to run daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, with output appended to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Fixed the pre-existing script (it contained leaked heredoc artifacts causing a runtime error) so it runs cleanly. Verified via manual execution before and after a full node reboot; cron entry, script, and log all persisted and remained functional, and the node's boot_id changed confirming a genuine restart.
